title: Balicasag tour guide fees questioned

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — A Bohol provincial board member has sought an inquiry into the collection of environmental or entrance fees from Department of Tourism (DOT)-accredited tour guides accompanying visitors to Balicasag Island in Panglao town, citing the need for clear and consistent policies across the province’s tourism destinations. Lawyer Jiselle Rae Aumentado Villamor, chair of the provincial board’s committee on tourism, raised the issue in a privilege speech on Tuesday, asking the provincial government to determine the legal basis for the fees, the collecting authority, and whether tour guides are covered by the charges.
